test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The manager had / thrown up the / drunk people sitting / inside his office premises.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "thrown up the." The correct verb phrase should be "thrown out the" when referring to someone being removed or forced to leave a place.
 
• "Thrown up" is used to describe the act of vomiting, which is not the intended meaning in this context.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager had thrown out the drunk people sitting inside his office premises."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "drunk people sitting" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "inside his office premises" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "The manager had" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
